{{Quote|Firing all plasma torpedoes now, Captain!''"<br />"''Heh, heh&hellip;Just like shooting acid rats in a crater!|The two heads of a Dyclops pirate|<ref name="D3" />}}
An '''unidentified Dyclops pirate''' served as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard the ''[[Blood Brother]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] commandeered by the notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reddjak]]. As a minion of Reddjak, that [[Dyclops]] was part of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]]. In the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Gender/Legends|he or she]] was arrested along with his crewmates by order of [[Zell]], former [[Republic Space Ranger]] and [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of [[Majoor]].<ref name="D3" />
